Spiky, jet black hair that sweeps across the forehead. Narrow, sharp obsidian eyes with a cold, disciplined gaze. Apparent age of mid-twenties with a stoic, angular face. Lean, athletic build. Wears a dark indigo samurai kimono with a silver plated breastplate and matching hakama pants. A long katana is strapped to the waist.
BODY COLOR: fair
